semiconductor_relevance: High — Millice PTE LTD is a distributor of process materials and equipment specifically for the semiconductor industry in the ASEAN region.
summary: Millice PTE LTD provides a range of process materials and equipment tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, offering sales, after-sales service, and application support across Southeast Asia. Their expertise includes high-performance materials and customized surfactants designed to enhance manufacturing processes from fabrication to testing.
